feat: a Pursue whose release failed offers Stop again until its runs are given back (#12)

With proof-agents#17 a pursuit whose release fails stays release-failed on its
Theorem, and Stop retries the release; while a Stop gives the runs back it is
stopping. The page shows Stop and hides Pursue on release-failed (whatever
can_pursue says) and says which Theorem holds its runs and why; a Stop that
fails again says RELEASE_FAILED and reads the view back. While the runs are
being given back neither button is offered. The hub counts both states as at
work, so Pursue is not offered, and a release-failed view is no longer read as
stopping. Reading, pursuing and the ended states keep their controls.

Closes #12

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat: a project Pursue's history is recorded and a new hub reads it back (#10)

The hub records each step of the pursuit it runs as core's pursuit events
(proof-cli#201): its start, the Reader's end, each Theorem it moves to (with
what that Theorem's Coordinator has spent), a Stop, a release that failed, and
its end. No provider starts unless the start is recorded: that refusal is
PURSUIT_RECORD_FAILED. A later step that cannot be recorded is kept and shown
with the pursuit (`record_error`), not passed over.

A release that failed is no end. Within the hub Stop retries it (#12), and the
end is recorded once the runs are given back. A hub that has not pursued
reads the last pursuit from its events: its end, or `interrupted` with the
last step it recorded. Nothing retries a release after a restart; a new Start
rechecks claims, snapshots and node states.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

+    def _budget(self, theorem: str | None) -> dict | None:

+    def _record_ending(self) -> None:

+"""proof-web#10: a project Pursue's history, recorded as core's pursuit events (proof-cli#201).
+
+The hub records each step of the pursuit it runs: its start (no provider starts unless that is recorded), the Reader's
+end, each Theorem it moves to, a Stop, a release that failed, and its end. A new hub reads the last pursuit back: its
+end, or `interrupted` with the last step it recorded. A release that failed is no end; after a restart it reads
+`interrupted` with that failure, and nothing offers to retry it there: a new Start rechecks claims.
+"""
+
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+from _review_client import DirectClient
+from proof_cli.proof_map import ProofMapError, create_node, list_nodes
+from proof_cli.storage import ensure_project
+
+pursuit = pytest.importorskip("proof_cli.pursuit")
+
+
+def _until(condition, timeout=10.0):
+    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
+    while not condition():
+        assert time.monotonic() < deadline, "timed out"
+        time.sleep(0.02)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def drafted(tmp_path: Path):
+    """A project with a draft in its library and no map; a test stands in for the Reader's turn."""
+    root = tmp_path / "project"
+    store = ensure_project(root)
+    (root / "library").mkdir()
+    (root / "library" / "main.tex").write_text("\\begin{theorem}T\\end{theorem}\n")
+    (root / "proof.toml").write_text('[studio]\nlibrary = ["library"]\n')
+    from proof_web import studios
+
+    if studios.ProjectPursuit is None:
+        pytest.skip("this proof-agents has no project pursuit")
+    clients = [DirectClient(store)]
+    yield store, clients
+    for client in clients:
+        client.app.close()
+
+
+def _view(client) -> dict:
+    return client.get("/api/pursue")[1]["data"]
+
+
+def _settled(client) -> bool:
+    return not client.app.studios._pursuit_busy()
+
+
+def _phases(store) -> list[tuple]:
+    [last] = pursuit.project_progress(store)[-1:]
+    return [(e["phase"], e["outcome"], e["theorem"]) for e in last["events"]]
+
+
+def _restart(store, clients) -> DirectClient:
+    """The server started again on the same project: a new hub, the old one left as it was."""
+    client = DirectClient(store)
+    clients.append(client)
+    return client
+
+
+class _Coordinator:
+    """A Theorem's Coordinator, standing in: it ends with `status` at once, or releases only after `fails` failures."""
+
+    def __init__(self, status="done", fails=0) -> None:
+        self.status, self.fails, self.released = status, fails, False
+
+    def start(self, provider):
+        return {"status": "running"}
+
+    def active(self):
+        return self.status == "running" and not self.released
+
+    def view(self):
+        return {"status": "released" if self.released else self.status, "reason": "", "settling": False, "turns": 3, "turns_max": 40}
+
+    def release(self):
+        if self.fails:
+            self.fails -= 1
+            return {"error": "L1 is still claimed by claude-code", "code": "RELEASE_FAILED"}
+        self.released = True
+        return {"status": "released"}
+
+
+def _needs_17():
+    from proof_web import studios
+
+    if not hasattr(studios.ProjectPursuit, "_release_failed"):
+        pytest.skip("needs proof-agents#17")
+
+
+def test_project_pursuit_ending_survives_a_new_hub(drafted):
+    """The audit probe: a Reader that stated no Theorem reads stuck, and still stuck in a new hub, never idle."""
+    store, clients = drafted
+    first = clients[0]
+    first.app.studios._read_turn = lambda provider: {}
+    assert first.post("/api/pursue/start", {"provider": "stub"})[0] == 200
+    _until(lambda: _view(first)["status"] == "stuck" and _settled(first))
+    second = _restart(store, clients)
+    view = _view(second)
+    assert (view["status"], view["reason"], view["recorded"]) == ("stuck", "the Reader stated no Theorem", True)
+    assert _phases(store) == [("start", "", None), ("reader_end", "ok", None), ("end", "stuck", None)]
+
+
+def test_a_reader_failure_is_recorded_as_the_pursuit_s_not_on_a_node(drafted):
+    store, clients = drafted
+    client = clients[0]
+    client.app.studios._read_turn = lambda provider: {"error": "no backend", "code": "READER_FAILED"}
+    client.post("/api/pursue/start", {"provider": "stub"})
+    _until(lambda: _view(client)["status"] == "stuck" and _settled(client))
+    assert _phases(store) == [("start", "", None), ("reader_end", "failed", None), ("end", "stuck", None)]
+    [last] = pursuit.project_progress(store)
+    assert last["events"][1]["reason"] == "no backend" and last["provider"] == "stub"
+    assert list_nodes(store) == []
+    assert "the Reader's turn failed: no backend" in _view(_restart(store, clients))["reason"]
+
+
+def test_each_theorem_and_its_end_are_recorded_with_what_it_spent(drafted):
+    store, clients = drafted
+    client = clients[0]
+    create_node(store, node_id="T1", kind="theorem", statement="T1 holds")  # a map already: no Reader turn
+    hub = client.app.studios
+    done = _Coordinator("done")
+    hub._coordinators["T1"] = done  # the hub's own: what it spent is read from it
+    hub.coordinator = lambda theorem: done
+    client.post("/api/pursue/start", {"provider": "stub"})
+    _until(lambda: _view(client)["status"] == "done" and _settled(client))
+    assert _phases(store) == [("start", "", None), ("theorem", "", "T1"), ("end", "done", None)]
+    [last] = pursuit.project_progress(store)
+    assert last["events"][1]["budget"] == {"turns": 3, "turns_max": 40}
+    assert _view(_restart(store, clients))["status"] == "done"
+
+
+def test_a_failed_release_is_recorded_and_its_retry_ends_the_pursuit(drafted):
+    _needs_17()
+    store, clients = drafted
+    client = clients[0]
+    create_node(store, node_id="T1", kind="theorem", statement="T1 holds")
+    held = _Coordinator("running", fails=1)
+    client.app.studios.coordinator = lambda theorem: held
+    client.post("/api/pursue/start", {"provider": "stub"})
+    _until(lambda: _view(client)["status"] == "pursuing")
+    assert client.post("/api/pursue/stop", {})[1]["error"]["code"] == "RELEASE_FAILED"
+    assert pursuit.project_progress(store)[-1]["status"] == "interrupted"  # a release that failed is no end
+    assert client.post("/api/pursue/stop", {})[0] == 200
+    assert _phases(store) == [("start", "", None), ("theorem", "", "T1"), ("stop", "", "T1"), ("release_failed", "", "T1"),
+                              ("stop", "", "T1"), ("end", "released", None)]
+    assert _view(_restart(store, clients))["status"] == "released"
+
+
+def test_after_a_restart_a_failed_release_reads_interrupted_with_its_reason_and_no_retry(drafted):
+    _needs_17()
+    store, clients = drafted
+    client = clients[0]
+    create_node(store, node_id="T1", kind="theorem", statement="T1 holds")
+    held = _Coordinator("running", fails=5)
+    client.app.studios.coordinator = lambda theorem: held
+    client.post("/api/pursue/start", {"provider": "stub"})
+    _until(lambda: _view(client)["status"] == "pursuing")
+    client.post("/api/pursue/stop", {})
+    assert _view(client)["status"] == "release-failed"  # this hub: Stop retries (proof-web#12)
+
+    second = _restart(store, clients)
+    view = _view(second)
+    assert (view["status"], view["last_phase"], view["current"]) == ("interrupted", "release_failed", "T1")
+    assert "L1 is still claimed by claude-code" in view["reason"] and "a new Start rechecks claims" in view["reason"]
+    status, answer = second.post("/api/pursue/stop", {})  # nothing to retry here: the old process is gone
+    assert status == 200 and answer["data"]["status"] == "interrupted"
+    assert held.fails == 4  # the new hub asked no release
+
+
+def test_a_start_that_cannot_be_recorded_starts_no_provider(drafted, monkeypatch):
+    from proof_web import studios
+
+    store, clients = drafted
+    client = clients[0]
+    read = []
+    client.app.studios._read_turn = lambda provider: read.append(provider) or {}
+
+    def refuses(*args, **kwargs):
+        raise ProofMapError("PURSUIT_RECORD_FAILED", "the pursuit's start could not be recorded: database is locked")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(studios, "record_pursuit", refuses)
+    status, answer = client.post("/api/pursue/start", {"provider": "stub"})
+    assert status == 500 and answer["error"]["code"] == "PURSUIT_RECORD_FAILED", answer
+    assert "database is locked" in answer["error"]["message"]
+    assert read == [] and client.app.studios._pursuit.view()["status"] == "idle"
+    assert pursuit.project_progress(store) == []
+
+
+def test_a_later_step_that_cannot_be_recorded_is_shown_not_passed_over(drafted, monkeypatch):
+    from proof_web import studios
+
+    store, clients = drafted
+    client = clients[0]
+    client.app.studios._read_turn = lambda provider: {}
+    record = studios.record_pursuit
+
+    def only_the_start(store, phase, **kwargs):
+        if phase != "start":
+            raise ProofMapError("PURSUIT_RECORD_FAILED", f"the pursuit's {phase} could not be recorded: disk full")
+        return record(store, phase, **kwargs)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(studios, "record_pursuit", only_the_start)
+    client.post("/api/pursue/start", {"provider": "stub"})
+    _until(lambda: _view(client)["status"] == "stuck" and _settled(client))
+    view = _view(client)
+    assert "was not recorded" in view["record_error"] and "disk full" in view["record_error"]
+
+
+def test_a_pursuit_stopped_with_the_server_records_its_end(drafted):
+    store, clients = drafted
+    client = clients[0]
+    create_node(store, node_id="T1", kind="theorem", statement="T1 holds")
+    running = _Coordinator("running")
+    client.app.studios.coordinator = lambda theorem: running
+    client.post("/api/pursue/start", {"provider": "stub"})
+    _until(lambda: _view(client)["status"] == "pursuing")
+    client.app.close()
+    clients.remove(client)
+    view = _view(_restart(store, clients))
+    assert view["status"] == "released" and _phases(store)[-1] == ("end", "released", None)

@@ -124,3 +124,24 @@ def test_the_other_statuses_keep_their_controls(status, stop, start):
             "can_pursue": status not in ("reading", "pursuing"), "stopping": False}
     (shown,) = _page(map_nodes=[], pursue=view)
     assert (shown["pursue"]["stop"], shown["pursue"]["start"]) == (stop, start)
+
+
+# -- the last pursuit, as a new server reads it back from its events (proof-web#10, proof-cli#201) ---------------------
+
+INTERRUPTED_REASON = ("stopped with the server after its release failed: the runs of T1 are still assigned: L1 is still claimed. "
+                      "no end was recorded: the process that ran it stopped; a new Start rechecks claims, snapshots and node states")
+
+
+def test_an_interrupted_pursuit_says_so_with_its_last_step_and_offers_pursue_not_stop():
+    view = {"status": "interrupted", "reason": INTERRUPTED_REASON, "theorems": ["T1"], "current": "T1", "results": {},
+            "recorded": True, "last_phase": "release_failed", "can_pursue": True, "stopping": False}
+    (shown,) = _page(map_nodes=[], pursue=view)
+    assert shown["pursue"]["shown"] and shown["pursue"]["start"] and not shown["pursue"]["stop"]
+    assert shown["pursue"]["status"] == f"interrupted — {INTERRUPTED_REASON}"
+
+
+def test_a_step_that_could_not_be_recorded_is_said_beside_the_pursuit():
+    view = {"status": "stuck", "reason": "the Reader stated no Theorem", "theorems": [], "current": None, "results": {},
+            "can_pursue": True, "stopping": False, "record_error": "its end was not recorded: disk full"}
+    (shown,) = _page(map_nodes=[], pursue=view)
+    assert shown["pursue"]["status"] == ("stuck — the Reader stated no Theorem · History not saved: its end was not recorded: disk full")
